alternativesConsidered: Freeze web mechanisms as universal purpose
context: Initial scope used browser-native execution; handoff 002 explicitly identifies that as one realization.
decision: Retain the current web baseline; allow alternate authoring languages, targets and transports when their obligations are independently verified.
mustSurvive: Essential meaning, access, authorized operations and truthful evidence
rationale: Preserves working adopters while distinguishing meaning from machinery.
revisitConditions: A new target provides equivalence and explicit migration evidence
title: Native-first web realization, not universal identity
